answer_1.quote: In this paper, we further bridge the gap between text and music by leveraging the power of NLP techniques to generate music conditioned on textual input.

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we deploy the widely adopted Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD) to assess the fidelity of the generated music distribution in comparison to the real music distribution.

answer_4.quote: We design a listener test where the annotators need to infer some coarse information of the text prompt behind a given piece of generated music.
answer_4.guideline: For Quality, consider how clear the audio sounds. Does it resemble a walkie-talkie or a high-quality studio sound system? For Melodiousness, pay attention to the rhythm and repetitiveness. For Harmoniousness, evaluate if multiple notes are in sync and enhance the effect.
